payout_quote: You will earn $100 when your referral becomes a member and opens a qualifying checking account or auto loan. Plus, we've added mortgages to the mix - if your referral closes on a mortgage with DFCU, you'll earn $275.
steps: Be an existing DFCU Financial member; register for the ReferLive program and share the offer with friends/family
Friend completes ReferLive registration and becomes a DFCU member
Friend opens a qualifying checking account (or auto loan of $15,000+, or closes a DFCU mortgage within 6 months)
For checking: within 90 days friend makes two (2) direct deposits of $100+ AND five (5) Mastercard debit transactions
You receive a $100 Mastercard Reward Card (or $275 if they close a mortgage); allow 4-6 weeks for delivery
catches: Cap: up to $1,000 in referral rewards per year
Rewards are Mastercard Reward Cards, not cash; 4-6 weeks delivery after qualification
Friend must be new to DFCU Financial (offer not available to existing members)
Checking requirements: two $100+ direct deposits + 5 debit transactions within 90 days
Auto loan: $15,000+ loan closed within 6 months; mortgages: closed within 6 months
Direct deposits must come from employer/government/corporations — not PayPal or person-to-person transfers
U.S. residents only; DFCU may amend/suspend/terminate the program at any time
biggest_catch: Your friend has to bank for real: two $100+ payroll deposits plus 5 debit purchases within 90 days — and your reward is a Mastercard card, not cash.
eligibility: Existing DFCU Financial members; referred friends must be new-to-DFCU members (U.S. residents)
timing: Checking qualifications within 90 days; auto/mortgage within 6 months; reward cards delivered 4-6 weeks after
